en.title: Logic Circuits of Absolute Zero
en.premise: In a city where memories circulate as currency, logic auditor Elias investigates a suspicious transaction involving a high-priced memory known as the 'Ice Castle.' The memory captures a perfect silence that should be physically impossible. As the investigation unfolds, Elias stumbles upon a fatal logical contradiction: the city's core system is 'freezing' and erasing specific memories to maintain social stability.

zh.title: 绝对零度的逻辑电路
zh.premise: 在一个记忆作为货币流通的城市里，逻辑审计官埃利亚斯正在调查一桩涉及高价“冰之城”记忆的异常交易。这段记忆记录了一种在物理上本不该存在的、完美的寂静。随着调查的深入，埃利亚斯撞见了一个致命的逻辑矛盾：为了维持社会稳定，城市的基干系统正在“冻结”并抹除特定的记忆。
